user.title: SmartThings Plus Setup
user.description: Enter your SmartThings Developer App Client ID and Client Secret.

auth_code.title: Authorize with SmartThings
auth_code.description:
1. [Click here to Authorize SmartThings]({auth_url})
2. Sign in to your Samsung account and click **Authorize**.
3. Copy the `code` parameter from the redirected URL (or copy the entire redirect URL) and paste it below.
